identity.name: Jupiter Farms
identity.notes: Gated single-family residential community in Jupiter, Palm Beach County, FL (ZIP 33458/33478), nicknamed "The Farms." Homes built 1942–2026, 3+ beds, 2+ baths, avg 2,112 sq ft. Median sold price $855,000 ($431/sq ft); 47% have private pools, 85% have garages. HOA established 07/07/2015, managed by FPMS (Sarasota). 4,700 sales in past 2 years, prices $585K–$3.25M, 55 avg days on market.

fees.note: Average HOA fee per horizonpalmrealty.com. florida-hoa.net confirms HOA fee required but lists no amount. hoa-agent.com cites Jupiter city-wide avg of ~$735/mo (not community-specific). Verify with association directly. PM: FPMS, 5600 Granada Dr, Sarasota FL 34231, 941-960-5000. Assoc website: jupiterfarmsresidents.com. No special assessment signals reported.
Average annual property taxes per horizonpalmrealty.com (separate from HOA dues).

Most properties in Jupiter Farms have no mandatory HOA fees; described as a rural community with a voluntary residents association. Some small sub-areas (e.g., Jupiter Farms Center) may have separate associations with their own fees. Conflicts with buyer notes describing a gated community with an active HOA (Jupiter Farms Residents Association Inc, est. 07/07/2015). Roads/drainage handled by South Indian River Water Control District via annual assessments on tax bills (no amount stated). Retrieved 2026-05-19T12:00:00Z, confidence 0.5 (aggregator site, not official HOA).

Jupiter Farms Residents Association Inc (entity N15000006731, ZIP 33458) fee has not yet been verified by residents; no amount published. Page notes the average monthly HOA fee in Jupiter (citywide) is approximately $735, which is not community-specific. No CDD/special assessment signals reported. Retrieved 2026-05-19T12:00:00Z, confidence 0.5 (public records + resident submissions, unverified).

amenities.detail: 47% of homes include a private pool

Jupiter Farms Park (public county park): athletic fields, playground, picnic areas, equestrian facilities, and pavilion. No traditional HOA-managed clubhouse or pool identified for the broader community. Retrieved 2026-05-19T12:00:00Z, confidence 0.5.
Nearby Riverbend Park provides extensive trails and recreation. Retrieved 2026-05-19T12:00:00Z, confidence 0.5.
Neighborhood known for large lots, equestrian trails, and natural beauty; equestrian-friendly lifestyle. Retrieved 2026-05-19T12:00:00Z, confidence 0.4 (community forum).
